parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols ldp interface all.explanation: 在所有接口上启用LDP协议。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 指定接口，'all'表示所有接口。

set protocols bgp group internal type in.command: set protocols bgp group internal type internal

set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group internal neighbor 3.3.3.9

set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] local-address [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group internal neighbor 3.3.3.9 local-address 1.1.1.9
set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP组邻居的本地地址。

set protocols bgp group internal family.command: set protocols bgp group internal family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group internal family.explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv4单播地址族。

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: 地址族的具体类型，'unicast'表示单播。

set protocols bgp group internal family.command: set protocols bgp group internal family l2vpn signaling
set protocols bgp group internal family.explanation: 配置BGP组支持L2VPN信令地址族。

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: 地址族的具体类型，'signaling'表示信令。

set protocols ospf area 0 interface lo0..command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface lo0.0

set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-2.command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-2/0/0.0

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep [parameter1] interface [parameter2] direction [parameter3]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep 1 interface ge-1/0/0 direction inward
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置以太网OAM连通性故障管理的MEP。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep [parameter1] continuity-check interval [parameter2]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep 1 continuity-check interval 100
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置MEP的连续性检查间隔。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep [parameter1] continuity-check enable
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management mep 1 continuity-check enable

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management remote-mep [parameter1]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management remote-mep 2

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management remote-mep [parameter1] continuity-check enable
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management remote-mep 2 continuity-check enable
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 启用远程MEP的连续性检查。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.9/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set routing-instances vpn1 instance-type.explanation: 配置路由实例的类型为L2VPN。

set routing-instances vpn1 interface ge-.explanation: 将接口绑定到路由实例。

set routing-instances vpn1 route-disting.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由区分符。

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: 路由区分符，用于区分不同VPN的路由。

set routing-instances vpn1 vrf-target im.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF目标导入策略。

parameters.name: vrf-target
parameters.explanation: VRF目标，用于控制路由的导入。

set routing-instances vpn1 vrf-target ex.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF目标导出策略。

parameters.name: vrf-target
parameters.explanation: VRF目标，用于控制路由的导出。
